text:
tara: Heads-up: planning to deploy an update to the dedicated GPU pool + autoscaler policy to prod-dedicated-1 today 16:00 PT. Small config changes: scale_down_grace 60s -> 120s, max_burst +2 nodes, eviction tweak. Rolling by slice, expect ~15–20m. Will smoke canary after slice 2. @raj @kevin can you own canary & rollout?

raj: I can own canary smoke (16:00-16:30 PT) and immediate rollback if needed. I'll run the smoke checklist and validate latency P95 and GPU utilization.

kevin: I'll do the rollout orchestration and monitor infra dashboards. Preparing rollback tag: `dedicated-pool-rollback-20260317`. PR #4321 contains the policy diff. Leaving one doc comment on the PR, otherwise LGTM.

anna: Checked the PR, LGTM from my side too. One tiny nits: comment on naming but not blocking. I validated the new scale down locally with the simulator.

tara: Great — @sara will you watch application-side metrics (prefix cache hit rate, KV cache pressure) during canary? If anything spikes we cut. :wave:

sara: Yep, I can watch logs and cache metrics. I'll set a quick alert for cache miss rate > 10% and latency increase > 15%. I'll post screenshots in this thread if anything odd.

kevin: Rollout runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-capacity-rollout (follow the rollback steps section). Quick paste of the policy snippet we'll apply: 
```
autoscaler:
  min_nodes: 3
  max_nodes: 22
  scale_up_step: 2
  scale_down_grace: 120s
  max_burst: 2
```

raj: Smoke checklist I'm running after canary: 
- start canary on slice-2
- run 30m of representative qps
- verify p95 latency within baseline
- verify GPU util stable and no OOMs
- verify no increase in error-rate > 0.5%
If all good, proceed to remaining slices.

infra-bot: Deployment scheduled: prod-dedicated-1 / autoscaler-config-2026-03-17T23:00Z -> in queue. Notifying oncall.

tara: Plan: start at 16:00 PT, canary slice at ~16:05, smoke for 30m, then continue rolling. Rollback ready: `kubectl rollout undo` + `image: dedicated-pool-rollback-20260317`. If anyone cannot make window, speak now. Otherwise I'll kick at 16:00. :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll post a short status update in #eng-oncall and ping if anything looks off.

anna: tagging @security for visibility (no config changes to secrets).

raj: Oncall + monitoring ready. See you at 16:00.

tara: Thank you — executing at 16:00 PT. Will post canary pass/fail and final timeline here.
